messages:
maria: quick check rolling out role-aware routing preview in console. should we show routing caps (qps/burst/region) per-role or keep it aggregate to avoid noise?

kyle: aggregate + a small badge that says "routing impacts present". click opens modal with route-level details.

ash: telemetry: any preview that executes sims must attach an id header so we can join traces: `X-Perm-Sim-ID: <uuid>`. also emit an audit event.

maria: agree. modal should show an estimated cost delta and a confidence indicator (low/medium/high) based on sample size.

kyle: backend constraints: sampling sims only (e.g. 1-2%) and enforce `sim_units` quota per-tenant + cooldown. otherwise infra will get paged.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for `role-routing-preview` -> 7% traffic (2025-09-10T10:02:00Z)
notes: ux: default off for "Show routing impact" toggle
